title: Track 3 coverage gap register
purpose: Machine-readable closure register for every canonical site/domain and every unresolved publisher field. Open states are work remaining; they are never interpreted as absence.

summary.semantics: PENDING and NOT_INGESTED are explicit states and are never interpreted as evidence of absence. RESEARCHED_NO_PUBLIC_RECORD means a site-specific search was performed and no public queue/service record was retained; it is not evidence that service is absent. Observation-ledger counts are canonical for retained derived remote-sensing observations; raw physical acquisition counts remain separate.

summary.scope: All 93 canonical Epoch AI frontier-AI reference sites
summary.purpose: Exhaustive gap inventory from canonical Track 3 artifacts plus a targeted live-public-source sweep. Public leads are not silently promoted to canonical evidence.
summary.reconciliation_note: Dossier missing_fields are preserved as historical/dossier gaps. effective_unresolved_publisher_fields subtract public enrichment values and targeted PUBLIC_SOURCE/RETAINED_SOURCE findings; secondary PUBLIC_LEAD_REVIEW_REQUIRED findings remain unresolved until canonical source review.

closure_rules: Do not mark a cell resolved merely because a source URL exists; retain the claim, locator, capture date and source-specific basis.
NO_PUBLIC_RECORD is a documented search outcome, not evidence of absence.
Queue capacity is not measured electricity demand.
A physical observation is evidence about the observed scene, not automatic proof of compute.
A public data-centre identity is not proof of covert status.
Independent corroboration requires explicit source-independence assessment; two records from the same source family are not independent.
